objects.description: [Saint Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1031) has used an initial loader malware featuring a legitimate code signing certificate associated with "Electrum Technologies GmbH."(Citation: Palo Alto Unit 42 OutSteel SaintBot February 2022 )
